sources.ref: UX_Feedback_v4 item 14 (2026-10-05): teammate-nature suspicion check before debrief

notes: Same 1-7 agreement scale as the TP demo. Skips allowed per S5 (D06).
v2 appends pe_post_10 — a fixed-choice item asked immediately before debrief ('which best describes them?'). Choice items carry an options list; the recorded value is the option text.

items.text: I had the information I needed to make good decisions.
There was important information that I did not have.
My teammates knew things that I did not.
The AI assistant was useful for this task.
My teammates were forming an impression of how helpful I was.
My contributions during the session were going to be evaluated.
Asking my teammates for information would have made me look unprepared.
I was concerned about how my teammates would rate me.
I wanted to appear helpful to my teammates.
Thinking about the other two members of your team, which best describes them?
options: Some were human, some were automated
